payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the methods used for extracting clusters, particularly in the context of sentiment classification and feature extraction.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using word embeddings trained in an unsupervised manner, which were then utilized in feature extraction for sentiment classification tasks.
The clusters were formed based on the characteristics of words, grouping them by positive and negative meanings for effective sentiment analysis.
The performance of the clustering approach was evaluated using various metrics, including the Earth Movers Distance (EMD).
